description: This Java class 'CommandWrapperBuilder' serves as a builder for constructing 'CommandWrapper' objects used to represent various commands and actions within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates the logic for creating, updating, deleting, and managing different entities such as clients, loans, accounts, reports, and system configurations by providing a fluent API to set command parameters and generate command objects.

classes.name: CommandWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to construct CommandWrapper instances for various command actions in Fineract.

methods.description: Constructs a CommandWrapper object using the current builder state.

methods.description: Constructs a CommandWrapper object with an explicit idempotency key.
